    } BY type.code, type.name FILTER entryDate <= coalesce($asOf(type: date)::date, current_date)),

INSERT rpt.export_events { report: $report(type: string, required), format: $format(type: string, required), filters: $filters(type: jsonb), rowCount: $rowCount(type: int, required) } -> { _id }

  $comp := SUMMARIZE EFFECTIVE ALL hr.compensation { rows := coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('payRate', payRate, 'currency', currency, 'payType', payType, 'payPeriod', payPeriod, 'changeReason', changeReason, 'effectiveFrom', _effectiveFrom, 'effectiveTo', _effectiveTo)), '[]'::jsonb) } FILTER employee == $e._id;
  SELECT hr.employees {
    employeeId := _id, employeeNumber, hireDate,
    profile := (SELECT person { _id, username, name, givenName, familyName, middleName, nickname, pronouns, locale, zoneinfo, _createdAt }),

    status := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL status { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo }),
    employmentType := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL employmentType { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo }),
    terminationReason := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL terminationReason { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo }),
    emails := (SELECT auth.emails { email, primary, _createdAt } FILTER user == $e.uid),
    phones := (SELECT auth.phone_numbers { * } FILTER user == $e.uid),
    addresses := (SELECT auth.addresses { * } FILTER user == $e.uid),
    emergencyContacts := (SELECT hr.emergency_contacts { * } FILTER employee == $e._id),
    compensation := $comp.rows,
    ptoRequests := (SELECT pto.requests { type := type.name, startDate, endDate, totalHours, status, note, decidedBy, decidedAt, decisionNote } FILTER employee == $e._id),
    ptoLedger := (SELECT pto.ledger { type := type.name, kind, hours, entryDate, reason } FILTER employee == $e._id),
